# The Shirtless Handyman

> Owner-operated microcement, tadelakt, and seamless-surface installation studio in New Orleans, Louisiana. Founder Ryan Mena personally installs every project — no subcontractors, no franchise, no call center. Serves the greater New Orleans metro including Metairie, Lakeview, Uptown, Mid-City, Bywater, French Quarter, Garden District, Gretna, and Harvey.

## Business identity

- **Business name:** The Shirtless Handyman

- **Team size:** One craftsman — no subcontractors

## Primary services

- **Microcement installation** — seamless waterproof mineral coating applied over existing tile, concrete, or drywall (when the tile assembly is inspected, cleaned, prepared, and confirmed to be stable). Used for shower walls, floors, kitchen backsplashes, feature walls. Seamless showers start around $3,000; full seamless bathrooms start around $6,000. Every job is quoted per project after a free site visit.
- **Tadelakt** — traditional Moroccan lime plaster, hand-burnished, naturally waterproof. Tadelakt follows the same pricing as microcement, though the final number can differ with surface preparation, application complexity, finish selection, and wet-area requirements.
- **Rockscape / sculpted feature walls** — foam sculpted and coated in microaggregate to look like carved natural stone. Optional integrated LED lighting. Starting around $3,500 as a standalone feature wall.
- **Pool deck resurfacing** — microterrazzo and cocciopesto. UV-stable, slip-resistant, built for NOLA sun. Starting around $3,000.
- **Venetian plaster, Roman clay, Marmorino, Beton cire** — additional decorative and functional seamless finishes. Venetian plaster and feature walls start around $3,000.
- **General handyman work** — drywall, fixture installs, painting, pressure washing. Available while on a seamless-surface job. $150–$500 per small job.

## Pricing

Most projects land between $3,000 and $10,000. Larger and luxury bathrooms are quoted higher, individually. Every job is quoted per project after a free site visit, so the client knows the number before anything starts.

- **Seamless shower** — Starting around $3,000. Microcement or tadelakt shower or tub surround. Microcement can often be installed over existing tile after the tile assembly is inspected, cleaned, prepared, and confirmed to be stable.
- **Full seamless bathroom** — Starting around $6,000; most land between $6,000 and $10,000. Larger and luxury bathrooms are quoted individually. Walls, floor, and shower in one continuous waterproof shell. **Every whole-bathroom renovation or whole-floor coating includes free underfloor heating — I buy the system and install it at no charge.**
- **Venetian plaster & feature walls** — Starting around $3,000.
- **Rockscape feature walls** — Starting around $3,500.
- **Pool deck resurfacing** — Starting around $3,000.

Final pricing depends on the condition of what's there, size, waterproofing, plumbing, fixtures, electrical work, access, and finish.

## What makes it different

- Installer works alone. No subcontractors, no crew handed off.
- Uses authentic imported systems (Italian microcement, Moroccan tadelakt lime), not generic concrete overlay.
- Applies directly over existing tile — no demolition, no dumpster, no removed subfloor.
- Fixed all-in pricing after a free in-home consultation. No change orders unless scope changes.
- Written warranty: 1 year on the sealer, 5 years on the substrate bond.

## How to book

1. **The Seamless Studio (AI preview)** — https://www.theshirtlesshandyman.com/upload — upload a photo of any room, get 3 AI-generated design previews of the finished space in microcement / tadelakt / rockscape with a real cost estimate. Free, no account required.
2. **Self-serve calendar** — https://www.theshirtlesshandyman.com/book — pick a free in-home walkthrough, phone consult, site prep visit, or project start date directly from Ryan's real availability. Mon–Sat, 9am–5pm Central.
3. **Text Ryan directly** — 504-264-4919. Average response under 1 hour.
4. **Quote form** — https://www.theshirtlesshandyman.com — quick name + phone form that texts Ryan a lead notification instantly.
